topics.name: Present Simple
topics.description: base verb (+s), for habits, facts and routines

topics.name: Present Continuous
topics.description: am/is/are + -ing, for actions in progress now or temporary situations

topics.name: Present Perfect
topics.description: have/has + past participle, for actions with a result or relevance now

topics.name: Present Perfect Continuous
topics.description: have/has been + -ing, for actions continuing up to now

topics.name: Past Simple
topics.description: past form of the verb, for finished actions at a known time

topics.name: Past Continuous
topics.description: was/were + -ing, for actions in progress at a moment in the past

topics.name: Past Perfect
topics.description: had + past participle, for an action completed before another past action

topics.name: Past Perfect Continuous
topics.description: had been + -ing, for an action continuing up to a moment in the past

topics.name: Future Simple
topics.description: will + base verb, for predictions, promises and spontaneous decisions

topics.name: Future Continuous
topics.description: will be + -ing, for actions in progress at a moment in the future

topics.name: Future Perfect
topics.description: will have + past participle, for actions completed before a moment in the future

topics.name: Going to
topics.description: be going to + base verb, for plans and intentions or predictions from evidence

topics.name: Zero Conditional
topics.description: if + present simple, present simple, for general truths and rules

topics.name: First Conditional
topics.description: if + present simple, will + base verb, for real future possibilities

topics.name: Second Conditional
topics.description: if + past simple, would + base verb, for hypothetical or unlikely situations

topics.name: Third Conditional
topics.description: if + past perfect, would have + past participle, for imagined past outcomes

topics.name: Mixed Conditional
topics.description: a past condition with a present result or the reverse, e.g. if I had studied, I would be a doctor

topics.name: Passive Voice
topics.description: be + past participle, the subject receives the action

topics.name: Reported Speech
topics.description: said/told that + shifted tense, reporting what someone said without quoting

topics.name: Modals of Ability
topics.description: can/could/be able to, for being able to do something

topics.name: Modals of Obligation
topics.description: must/have to/should, for obligation, necessity and advice

topics.name: Modals of Possibility
topics.description: may/might/could, for things that are possible but not certain

topics.name: Modals of Deduction
topics.description: must be/can't be, for conclusions drawn from evidence

topics.name: Gerund vs Infinitive
topics.description: verb + -ing or verb + to-infinitive, e.g. enjoy reading, want to read

topics.name: Phrasal Verbs
topics.description: verb + particle with its own meaning, e.g. give up, look after

topics.name: Used to / would
topics.description: used to + base verb or would + base verb, for past habits and states that no longer hold

topics.name: Comparatives and Superlatives
topics.description: -er/more … than and the -est/the most, for comparing

topics.name: Relative Clauses
topics.description: who/which/that/where clauses that define or add information about a noun

topics.name: Question Tags
topics.description: a statement followed by a short tag question, e.g. it's cold, isn't it?

topics.name: Wish / if only
topics.description: wish/if only + past tense forms, for regrets and unreal wishes

topics.name: Articles
topics.description: a/an/the or no article, chosen by whether the noun is specific, countable or general

topics.name: Countable and Uncountable Nouns
topics.description: much/many, a little/a few, some/any with countable and uncountable nouns
